content.title: Set up dual-format documentation generation
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/docs-generation.md

Configure TypeDoc to produce two documentation formats from the same JSDoc source:
1. HTML docs at docs/html/ (for users, GitHub Pages)
2. Markdown docs at docs/md/ (for AI agents, concise format)

CTO pre-requisites completed:
- .gitignore updated (docs/ replaces docs-html/)
- library-release access updated (docs/** added)
- release workflow updated (deploys from docs/html/)
